title: Shiraishi An — Intimate Feeling〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, I'm done wiping the tables. What's next...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(I wonder if Kohane and Toya are okay.
I hope they can talk it out with their parents...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Well, it probably went okay for Kohane,
but I'm worried about Toya...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: An... Hey, you there?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, sorry! Let's see, what was next...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Have you checked the tableware yet?
One table was low on sugar, I think...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, right! That!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Sigh... Are you really that worried about those two?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh... You can tell?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: It's all over your face.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
But they're your friends.
Of course you'd be worried.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Say, dad...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yeah?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Just if... What if we had a serious disagreement about what I wanted to do with my life? What would you do?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Why are you even asking? Do you really think anything I say will stop you from pursuing what you've decided to do?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh... I guess...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: And I've lived my whole life staying true to my passion so...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: It'd be hypocritical of me to try to put my own views on a pedestal and stop you from chasing your own goals.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Come to think of it, you've always been supportive of the things I want to do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I didn't realize how lucky I was... I feel silly for telling the others to just talk it out with their parents or invite their parents to our gig...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Wow...! In retrospect, everything I said feels really thoughtless...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sorry... Are you closed already?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Kohane?!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: We were just changing over to the bar menu. I can't take any orders right now, but you're welcome to come in for a chat.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Go talk to your friend, An.
You're too spacey to be helpful now anyway.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um... Thanks, dad.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane, what's up...?
I thought you were going straight home today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was but... I wanted to come up with a strategy first.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: About what?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You see, I thought that instead of just inviting my parents to an event, I should assure them first that live houses aren't sketchy or dangerous places.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You know, I felt nervous walking around Vivid Street when I first came here...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'd rather have my parents feel some sort of wonder or excitement about where we're going instead of just flatly labeling it a scary place.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I totally agree!
Do you have something in mind?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Well, I thought that maybe this would work...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cool! You made a photobook!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. I gathered fliers and pamphlets from the events we took part in for this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You even wrote notes about each venue!
And about the other groups that were there too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, this is awesome! This is definitely gonna make your parents see what we do from your perspective!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank goodness. I'm glad you think so!
I'll finish it up and show it to them!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Great!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You really are amazing, Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Once you put your mind to something,
you stay completely dedicated to it.
I think that's really amazing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But you actually gave me the idea to make a photobook.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh, I did?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You said, Have them see it for themselves.
And I might've come up with the same idea...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I would've been too worried about it backfiring on me if I did...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But back then, you also said,
A picture is worth a thousand words.
Then I knew this was the best thing to do.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So... Thank you, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I was just throwing ideas around, you know?
You're giving me too much credit!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright! How about this?
I'll help you with your photobook.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Absolutely! Your future as a member of our team hinges on it, right?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Here we go again...
An's back to her usual self.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Looks like I'll have to give her the rest of the day off.
